references.text: Balaam tells Balak to stand by the burnt offering while he goes to meet the Lord; this same pattern is repeated here in verse 17.
The same situation as in verse 17: Balaam returns to Balak, who stands by the burnt offering together with the princes of Moab.
Balak took Balaam and the princes of Moab to see the people of Israel, setting the stage for the sacrificial ritual.
Balaam explains that he can only speak what the Lord says, which is the answer to Balak's question, 'What has the Lord spoken?'
Balaam declares that he can only speak the word God puts in his mouth, relevant to Balak's question about what the Lord has said.
